plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp build for boxing with enough room left for sparring and skill work. Week 1 establishes simple training baselines on the main lifts so percentage work can be used safely from Week 2 onward. The block builds general strength first, keeps power work present in low-fatigue doses, and adds only recoverable endurance that should not compete with boxing sessions. Week 4 is a deload that keeps speed and movement quality while cutting fatigue. At the end of Week 4, review recovery, sparring load, and the estimated maxes before the next block is generated.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish main lift baselines, build general strength, and keep power and aerobic work present without stealing from boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength lifts and start converting more of that force into faster, cleaner power output.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in smaller doses and express it through sharper boxing-relevant speed, rotation, and repeatable power.
